review.scope: Only ELF x86-64 Clang activates the shared 32-bit VEX output; four other compiler/host profiles must retain byte-identical binaries and existing runtime objects. Active profiles run all real PE and mixed-architecture panels, with no outlier removal.
review.checksum_scope: Native timing checks instruction boundaries, rejections and selected consumed output values. Owner units run in the separate pilot and configuration suites. The separate local active-path probe compares complete cs_insn/cs_detail records, untouched bytes, cursors and errors for 162398208 inputs and guarded-page extents. These are distinct validation surfaces.
